edits.old: this story's pattern set does not include the access pattern, so it adds no dependency for the guard and holds no role table.
edits.new: this story's pattern set does not include the access pattern (DP-08), so it calls no rwb-access authorise check and adds no dependency for the guard; the declared right is enforced at gateway-bff and by the service's own operation configuration, which refuses an absent right with 403 MSG-P4-002, and it holds no role table.

edits.old: task queue `rwb-document` (not used by this story).
edits.new: task queue `rwb-document` (not used by this story). Operation paths follow the Ownership Map and TSD P5 API-P5-016 (`POST /cases/{caseId}/generated-documents`); the architecture v5 slide 16 name `POST /documents/generate` is not used (ASM-101). The template version and the merge field list are read only through RWB-P6-E1046-CON, and no template row is held (ASM-102). P6 rwb-comms owns the template version, its Legal approval and the merge field catalogue; this slice supplies its own treatment values and never reads the catalogue as a table (GAP-1879).

edits.old: No column is added: `document.template_id` (DF-DOC-032), `document.doc_version`, `document.previous_version_id` and the `document_field` columns already exist in TSD P5 v2 T3.1.
edits.new: Two columns are added to `document` beside `template_id` and `treatment_id`: `template_code` varchar(30) and `template_version` integer (ASM-103). `document.template_id` (DF-DOC-032), `document.doc_version`, `document.previous_version_id` and the `document_field` columns already exist in TSD P5 v2 T3.1.

edits.old: One index, `ix_document_template` on `document` (`template_id`, `doc_version`), so the version chain of a document is one index range.
edits.new: One partial unique index, `ix_document_template` on `document` (`treatment_id`, `template_id`) where `state` is DRAFT and `is_active` (ASM-103); the version chain is read through `doc_version` and `previous_version_id`.

edits.old: - The five reference lists arrive through the rwb-case reference-data contract (DP07).
edits.new:
- The five reference lists arrive through the rwb-case reference-data contract (DP07).
- The field registry (`sys_fields`, GET /api/recovery/source-data/v1/admin/data-dictionary/fields, P1 rwb-source-data) is read as one hop with a 2 s timeout against the published data-dictionary document as a fake (DP-11); its contract dependency is Not specified in the source documents (GAP-1064).
- This slice loads no reference data: POST /admin/reference-loads is P3 rwb-case, the field-ID check sits behind the P1 data dictionary contract and the template body sits with P5 rwb-document; a load with any refused row is refused in full and one decision record is written per version approval (GAP-0360).
